rebase_reason: Exact-binding and strip-spacing card adopted; six class keys remain outside legacy CLASS_STEPS.
matching: Exact case-sensitive model names, no prose substring match; unique genes, not domain-row counts.
claim_limit: Detected families support capacity hypotheses. Missing annotations are not absence, and no rule establishes product identity, production, activity or physical linkage.

classification_note.hydrogen-cyanide: Existing classification note only; no step/domain map.

steps.label: Type III polyketide scaffold formation
steps.interpretation: Either signature supports a type III PKS family assignment. Condensation and scaffold cyclization can reside in one enzyme; do not require separate T1PKS AT, ACP, reductive-loop or release modules. One terminal-domain hit can be a fragment.

steps.label: Branch-specific downstream modifications
steps.interpretation: Report individually annotated modifying-enzyme families when present. No universal domain list establishes the product, substrate choice or final cyclization pattern.

steps.label: Fatty-acid-synthase or initiating condensing-enzyme family
steps.interpretation: Loose detection signature. These families also serve primary metabolism; a hit does not establish a specialized-metabolite cluster or a particular fatty acid.

steps.label: Carrier and reductive-cycle components
steps.interpretation: The native detection rule does not specify one obligatory carrier/reductase/dehydratase set. Retain the observed families, but do not turn their absence from a bounded region into missing pathway steps.

steps.label: RiPP-related family signature
steps.interpretation: This is an OR-list of alternative RiPP-related signatures, not sequential steps. Keep a DUF692-only gene label unknown; the region fallback classification is a separate claim.

steps.label: Precursor and family-specific maturation
steps.interpretation: A precursor may lack an annotated Pfam domain. Require an explicit precursor feature or independently supported family assignment before displaying a specific precursor/maturation step. Never mark all families in the OR-list as required.

steps.label: Quinone isoprenoid side-chain synthesis
steps.interpretation: Supports the long-chain prenyltransferase family used for quinone side chains. Does not by itself demonstrate quinone head-group synthesis, prenyl attachment, a specific cofactor, or its production.

steps.label: Quinone head group and attachment
steps.interpretation: These are separate biochemical requirements. Do not manufacture domain requirements from the shorthand display label quinone.

steps.label: AfsA-family scaffold-forming capacity
steps.interpretation: AfsA supports a family-level scaffold-forming signature, not a particular signaling molecule.

steps.label: Reduction and dephosphorylation
steps.interpretation: The primary study describes alternative routes. Generic reductase or phosphatase domains are insufficient to identify these steps; require a specific characterized-reference match before naming them.

steps.label: TetR-family regulation context
steps.interpretation: A TetR-family domain alone does not identify a butyrolactone receptor. Display regulation-family context only; do not count it as a scaffold-biosynthesis step.

steps.label: Native nucleoside-pathway signature
steps.interpretation: Alternative pathway markers. Do not demand all models or infer a universal nucleoside route. ToyB occurs in the inspected 7.1.0 rule, not the inspected 8.0.4 rule; version-specific additions require explicit provenance.

steps.label: TruD-family context (branch unassigned)
steps.interpretation: Only discuss the characterized-reference branch when the reference comparison supports it. An isolated TruD-family hit is compatible with ordinary RNA modification and does not identify a nucleoside antibiotic.

steps.label: Branch-specific scaffold modifications
steps.interpretation: Keep individual domain families visible. Do not transfer the full malayamycin, polyoxin or nikkomycin pathway to an unassigned locus.
